description_en: Modifies the burstable protection bandwidth of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance in the Chinese mainland
description_zh: 修改DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的弹性防护带宽
name: ModifyElasticBandWidth

parameters.help_en:
The burstable protection bandwidth that you want to set. Unit: Gbps.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91502.html to query the available burstable protection bandwidth specifications
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的弹性防护带宽，单位：Gbps。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91502.html查询可选的弹性防护带宽规格
parameters.name: elastic_bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
The instance must be in a normal state. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
实例必须处于正常状态。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id
